finding.title: License authority falls back to a publicly derivable signing key
finding.evidence: Absent or wrong-length BABYLON_LICENSE_ED25519_SEED falls back to SHA-256 of a source-code literal (98-102), then output is labeled VALID_AUTHENTICATED_LICENSE (115).
finding.trigger: Generate a certificate without an explicitly configured valid signing seed.
finding.impact: Anyone with this source can derive the identical authority key and forge certificates signed with the default key. No runtime verifier consumer was established; finding applies to issued certificate authenticity.

adjudications.source_checks: CLI main at tools/tamkarum_license_provisioner.py:207 and onboarding daemon at scripts/zero_touch_onboarding_daemon.py:114 call issuer. Lines97-115 choose a source-derived seed and label output authenticated. No production pinned-key verifier established.
adjudications.scope: Retained P1 for issued-certificate authenticity; no entitlement-enforcement bypass asserted.

finding.title: Consolidation discards divergent same-name master ledgers
finding.evidence: _process_master_db returns True when destination already exists (lines 33-35); caller then unconditionally calls _purge_db_file.
finding.trigger: A master ledger exists in ~/.babylon60/dbs and the repository contains a different ledger with the same basename.
finding.impact: Source ledger and sidecars are deleted without comparing, merging, or preserving its records.

adjudications.source_checks: Read consolidate_dbs.py:26-35 and50-82. Main calls consolidate_dbs; existing destination returns True; caller always invokes purge at70, no equality/content/backup guard.
adjudications.scope: Retained P1: divergent same-name source loss on explicit local CLI execution.

finding.title: Copying only SQLite main file loses WAL commits
finding.evidence: shutil.copy2 copies only db_path; _purge_db_file unlinks its -wal and -shm at lines 41-42.
finding.trigger: Consolidate a WAL-mode master ledger with committed pages still in its WAL.
finding.impact: Central copy omits committed transactions, then the source WAL carrying them is removed.

adjudications.source_checks: Read consolidate_dbs.py:30-42 and63-70. Only main database copied; caller removes main and WAL/SHM. No SQLite backup API, checkpoint or writer exclusion.
adjudications.scope: Retained P1 conditional on committed live WAL; no destructive reproduction executed.

finding.title: Extension purge accepts directory traversal as extension ID
finding.evidence: Only nonempty input is checked (158-161); os.path.join(profile, Extensions, ext_id) is passed to shutil.rmtree (171-173), also for settings paths (179-181).
finding.trigger: Invoke purge --id ../.. or provide an absolute directory as --id.
finding.impact: Deletion escapes the extension directory and can recursively delete the browser root or another writable directory.

adjudications.source_checks: Read browser_forensics.py:157-181 and targeted dispatcher at271. Nonempty ID alone is checked; os.path.join passes absolute or traversal target to rmtree; no containment guard.
adjudications.scope: Retained P1 local destructive CLI input validation; not a remote entrypoint claim.

finding.title: Native Hamming batch accepts buffers shorter than its stride
finding.evidence: flat_batch joins arbitrary byte strings; q_len alone is passed as the native stride without validating each length. Cross-file utils/void_accel.c:28,34-35 and 58,64-65 read each target at i*len.
finding.trigger: A compatible native library is loaded and a batch member is shorter than query.
finding.impact: Native code reads outside the provided batch buffer; malformed input can crash the process or compute distances from unrelated memory. Native-library loading was not exercised.

adjudications.source_checks: Read void_vec.py:48-92,119-131 and utils/void_accel.c:18-79. Public batch joins variable-length buffers and passes query length as stride. C reads count*len. Loader requires compatible .so beside transducers module; build provenance not established.
adjudications.scope: Retained P1 conditional native-memory safety defect. No native load/PoC executed; scalar-only execution is not affected.

adjudications.title: SIMD loop bound underflows for short equal-length vectors
adjudications.trigger: Compatible NEON accelerator receives len <16, or AVX512 accelerator len<64, including equal-length query and batch.
adjudications.evidence: size_t len is unsigned; j<=len-16 / j<=len-64 underflows before comparison and enters vector load at j=0.
adjudications.impact: Out-of-bounds reads and potential crash even without batch length mismatch.
adjudications.limitation: Native library compilation/loading and exact artifact provenance not verified; no runtime PoC.

tool_limitations: Static independent source checks; no tests or effects executed.
